editorNote: Ouest France Bistro in Mornington is permanently closed. This record is retained for historical reference and is excluded from public venue listings and routes.

heroImage.alt: Brightly painted bathing boxes along a sandy beach, people on the sand and houses among trees on the hillside above.
heroImage.depicts: brightly painted bathing boxes along a bay beach below a wooded hillside

closureNote: Recorded here as permanently closed, and that does not survive a check. Checked 2026-09-13: Ouest France Bistro is listed as open and carries reviews into 2026 on Tripadvisor (https://www.tripadvisor.com/Restaurant_Review-g552216-d25217948-Reviews-Ouest_France_Bistro-Mornington_Mornington_Peninsula_Victoria.html), is bookable on OpenTable (https://www.opentable.com/r/ouest-france-bistro-mornington) and is carried by AGFG (https://www.agfg.com.au/restaurant/ouest-france-bistro-124964). Those sources place it at 180 Main Street, Mornington, not the address recorded here. No closure announcement from the operator was found. Status left as recorded pending an editor decision; the closure claim should not be repeated until it is re-evidenced.
